name: The Surf Club Restaurant
address: Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club, Surfside, 9011 Collins Ave., Surfside, 33154
dinnerNote: À la carte; mains about $38–$105, steaks $125–$245
hotel: the Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club
bookingOpens: Online on Resy, or by phone. Dinner only, six nights a week (closed Mondays).
walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome at the bar, where the full menu is served, and at part of the dining room.
groups: Private dining indoors, outdoors or off site is arranged with the private dining and events manager (+1 305 768 9442).
dressCode: Smart casual. No shorts or flip-flops; jackets and ties are not required.
byob: Up to three 750ml bottles not on the wine list, at $125 corkage a bottle.

stay.name: Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club
stay.note: The restaurant’s own site says it sits at The Surf Club next to the Four Seasons hotel.
